attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts and endorses the causal claim.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the asserted causal link between the named leaders' LLM expansion, widespread junk content, and worsening online information.

contract.note: The plain reading reasonably treats the language as widespread proliferation and consequential deterioration by June 9, 2025. It fairly requires neither majority coverage nor exclusive causation.

evidence.note: Timely synthetic-content measurements establish growth, but neither unreliable-site classification nor AI authorship establishes article quality. The study does not establish provider attribution or causal deterioration.

The investigation documents actual low-quality and false AI-generated publications before the statement. It supports the pollution component, but does not establish broader deterioration in users' information exposure.

OpenAI's company disclosure confirms misuse of its models for deceptive operations. This supports a contribution to pollution; its reported absence of meaningful audience gains limits the exposure inference.
The company disclosure establishes Microsoft's infrastructure, investment, and deployment role. It does not measure resulting content pollution or information-quality deterioration.

The investigation documents substantial manipulated publication and probable OpenAI model use. Attribution remains probabilistic, and amplification of manually crafted material does not establish exposure to generated articles.

The search sample limits inferences from production to visibility. Its AI-content estimates do not measure quality or provider responsibility, so lower rankings do not establish absence of deterioration.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes examples of substantial AI-generated pollution, some linked to OpenAI, and Microsoft's enabling role. It does not establish the broader causal deterioration in information encountered by users by June 9, 2025. Limited engagement and search visibility constrain the inference without disproving the claim.
